source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS Astronomical-Book fragments (4Q208-4Q211) where preserved; Ge'ez as fallback. NO continuous Greek witness for chs 72-82.
source.transliteration_convention: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic per Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez DJD XXXVI 2000; Ge'ez SBL convention.
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976, Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000, Drawnel 2011, Neugebauer 1985.
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI + Drawnel 2011 + Black 1985 + Charles 1912 + Knibb 1978 + Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012.
source.citation: Milik 1976; Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000; Drawnel 2011; Black 1985 (with Neugebauer 1985); Charles 1912 PD; Knibb 1978; Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 81 — URIEL + the HEAVENLY TABLETS; Enoch instructed by SEVEN HOLY ONES; 1-YEAR-WITH-HIS-CHILDREN-THEN-ASSUMED commission. **The heavenly-tablets motif** is foundational to Enochic + Jubilees + Qumran literature — these are the cosmic records of all that is, was, and shall be. **The 7-angel instruction frame** anticipates the seven archangels of 1 En 20 (Watchers tour) + Rev 1:4 (the seven spirits before the throne) + Rev 8:2 (the seven angels with trumpets). Some Aramaic 4Q211 may preserve fragmentary parallel.

verses.text_geez: ወይቤለኒ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ነጽር፡ ውስተ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወአንብብ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወአእምሮ፡ ኵሎ፡ በበ፡ ኪሉ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbēlanī Henok naṣṣər wəsta ṣəlāta samāy wa-ʾanbəb zaṣəḥuf lāʿlēhomu wa-ʾaʾəməro kwəlo baba kilu
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic 4Q211 frag 1 col. i possibly preserves fragmentary parallel material (Drawnel 2011 pp. 358-364)
verses.notes: **'HENOCH, LOOK ON THE TABLETS OF HEAVEN, READ WHAT IS WRITTEN UPON THEM, AND LEARN EVERYTHING in detail.'** **The HEAVENLY TABLETS (ṣəlāta samāy)** are the cosmic-records-of-all-things. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Jub 4:5, 32:21-22 (heavenly tablets recording deeds); cf. Ex 32:16 (the original tablets at Sinai); cf. Test. Lev. 5:4 (Levi shown heavenly tablets). The Enochic heavenly-tablets are the source-of-revelation paradigm — Enoch as celestial-scribe reads + transcribes.

verses.text_geez: ወነጸርኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወአንበብኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘጽሑፍ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ወአእመርኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወአንበብኩ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብረ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ውሉደ፡ ሥጋ፡ እለ፡ ይከውኑ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ እስከ፡ ለትዉልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡
verses.translit: wa-naṣṣarku kwəlo ṣəlāta samāy wa-ʾanbabku kwəlo zaṣəḥuf lāʿlēhomu wa-ʾaʾəmarku kwəlo wa-ʾanbabku maṣḥafa kwəlu gəbra sabʾ wa-kwəlu wəluda śəgā ʾəlla yəkawwənu lāʿla mədr ʾəska la-təwlədomu la-ʿālam
verses.notes: **Enoch READS THE TABLETS = the book of every human deed forever.** Predestinarian / determinist frame. Cross-corpus: cf. Dan 12:1 (book of the living); cf. Ps 139:16 (book recording days); cf. Rev 20:12 (books opened at judgment); cf. Rev 13:8 + 17:8 (the lamb's book of life from the foundation of the world).

verses.text_geez: ወባረክዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ንጉሠ፡ ክብር፡ ዘገብረ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብረ፡ ዓለም፡ ወአእኮትክዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ በእንተ፡ ትዕግሥቱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ውሉደ፡ አዳም፡
verses.translit: wa-bārakəwwo la-ʾəgziʾabḥēr nəguśa kəbr zagabra kwəlo gəbra ʿālam wa-ʾaʾəkotku-wwo la-ʾəgziʾabḥēr ba-ʾənta təʿgəśtu lāʿla wəluda ʾAdām
verses.notes: **ENOCH'S DOXOLOGY: 'I blessed the Lord, the King of Glory.'** Enoch praises Yahweh's patience with humanity. The 'King of Glory' title — cf. Ps 24:7-10.

verses.text_geez: ወእቤ፡ በበ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ብፁዕ፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘይመውት፡ ጻድቅ፡ ወሠናይ፡ ዘዘፍርደ፡ ኢተጽሕፈ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ወዘዕለተ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ኢተረክበ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəbē baba gizēhu bəḍuʿ zawəʾətu bəʾsi zayəmawwət ṣādəq wa-śannāy zaza-fərda ʾitaṣəḥfa lāʿlēhu wa-zaʿəlata kwənanē ʾitarakba
verses.notes: **BEATITUDE: 'Blessed is the man who dies righteous and good, against whom no record of unrighteousness has been written.'** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. the Beatitudes of Matt 5; cf. 4Q525 (Qumran Beatitudes); cf. Sir 14:1-2 (blessed is the one whose conscience does not accuse him). The 'no record written' frame = clear conscience before the heavenly judgment.

verses.text_geez: ወእልክቱ፡ ሰብዐቱ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ አምጽኡኒ፡ ወአንበሩኒ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ቅድመ፡ ዐጸዱ፡ ለቤትየ፡ ወይቤሉኒ፡ ንግሮሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ለወልድከ፡ ማቱሳላ፡ ወአርኢ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ ውሉድከ፡ ከመ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘያስተበቍዕ፡ ሥጋ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ እስመ፡ ፈጣሪ፡ ውእቱ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəlləktu sabʿatu qəddusān ʾamṣəʾuni wa-ʾanbaru-ni lāʿla mədr qədma ʿaḍadu la-bētəya wa-yəbēlu-ni nəgəromu kwəlo la-waldə-ka Mātusālā wa-ʾarʾi la-kwəlomu wəlud-ka kama ʾalbo zayāstabaqqwəʿ śəgā qədmēhu la-ʾəgziʾabḥēr ʾəsma faṭāri wəʾətu
verses.notes: **THE SEVEN HOLY ONES bring Enoch back to earth.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: the seven archangels — cf. 1 En 20:1-8 (Uriel, Raphael, Raguel, Michael, Saraqael, Gabriel, Remiel); cf. Tob 12:15 ('I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels'); cf. Rev 1:4 (the seven spirits before the throne); cf. Rev 8:2 (the seven trumpet-angels). **The seven archangels are central to Enochic angelology.** They charge Enoch: 'tell Methuselah and all your sons that no flesh is righteous before God, for he is the Creator.'

verses.text_geez: አሐደ፡ ዓመተ፡ እንኅድግከ፡ ምስለ፡ ውሉድከ፡ እስከ፡ ታጸንዕ፡ ዳግመ፡ ወትምህር፡ ውሉደከ፡ ወትጽሕፍ፡ ሎሙ፡ ወትሰምዕ፡ ሎሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወትዜንዎሙ፡ ለውሉደ፡ ውሉድከ፡ ካዕበ፡
verses.translit: ʾaḥada ʿāmata ʾənḫədəggə-ka məsla wəlud-ka ʾəska tāṣannəʿ dāgəma wa-təməhər wəluda-ka wa-təṣəḥf lomu wa-təsamməʿ lomu kwəlo wa-təzēnəwwomu la-wəluda wəlud-ka kāʿba
verses.notes: **'ONE YEAR I WILL LEAVE YOU WITH YOUR SONS to teach your sons, write for them, and testify to them all and to your sons' sons.'** **The ONE-YEAR EARTHLY-RETURN of Enoch** is a distinct Enochic motif — Enoch returns from heaven to teach his descendants and then is finally taken. **The Enoch-as-pedagogue role** is the foundation of the Enochic-instruction-tradition. Cross-corpus: this is the bridge to the Epistle of Enoch (chs 91-108) where Enoch addresses Methuselah and his descendants directly.

verses.text_geez: ወበአመ፡ ካልዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ይትነሥኡከ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡ ወልብከ፡ ይጸንዕ፡ እስመ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ዘጻድቀ፡ ኆሊቆሙ፡ ይከውን፡ ወኃጥአን፡ ይትኄሰሱ፡ ለበበ፡ ኃጢአቶሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-ʾama kāləʿ ʿāmat yətnaśśəʾu-ka ʾəmənna mədr qədmēhomu wa-ləbbə-ka yəṣannəʿ ʾəsma ṣādəqān zaṣādəqa ḫolaqomu yəkawwən wa-ḫāṭəʾān yətḫēsasu laba-ḫāṭiʾatomu
verses.notes: **'In the second year they shall take you from their midst.'** **The FINAL ASSUMPTION** of Enoch from earth at the end of the second year. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Gen 5:24 ('Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him' — the primordial assumption-motif); cf. 1 En 70-71 (the Parables' assumption of Enoch); cf. 2 Enoch 67-68 (extended assumption narrative). The Genesis 5:24 'taking' is the seed-text from which all Enochic literature grows.

verses.text_geez: ወዘይፈቅድ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ለበበ፡ ጊዜሆሙ፡ ይፈጽም፡ ሎሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብረ፡ ሠናየ፡ እንበለ፡ ሐሰት፡ ወእንበለ፡ ኃጢአት፡
verses.translit: wa-zayəfaqqəd ṣādəq laba-gizēhomu yəfaṣṣəm lomu kwəlo gəbra śannāya ʾənbala ḥassat wa-ʾənbala ḫāṭiʾat
verses.notes: Charge to the righteous: complete every good work.

verses.text_geez: ብዙኃን፡ ኀጥአን፡ ይተኀጐሉ፡ በውስተ፡ ኃጢአቶሙ፡ እስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብሮሙ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ይኩን፡ ጻድቀ፡
verses.translit: bəzuḫān ḫāṭəʾān yətaḫaggwalu ba-wəsta ḫāṭiʾatomu ʾəska kwəlu gəbromu ṣādəqān yəkun ṣādəqa
verses.notes: Many sinners shall perish; the deeds of the righteous shall be righteous.

verses.text_geez: ወይእዜ፡ ወልድየ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘንተ፡ እነግረከ፡ ወእጽሕፈከ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ኵሎ፡ ከሠትኩ፡ ለከ፡ ወአንሣእኩ፡ ለከ፡ ለመጽሐፍት፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኵሉ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəʾəzē waldə-ya kwəlo zanta ʾənaggərə-ka wa-ʾəṣəḥfa-ka kiyāhu kwəlo kaśatku la-ka wa-ʾansāʾəku la-ka la-maṣaḥəft kiyāhomu kwəlu
verses.notes: **'NOW MY SON, I TELL YOU ALL THESE THINGS AND WRITE THEM FOR YOU. I have revealed all to you, and given you the books concerning all.'** **Enoch as scribe FOR Methuselah** — completes the transmission-chain frame. The Enochic-instruction-tradition lays the groundwork for the Epistle (chs 91-108).
